narrative: Material PL2__M6CB4360 exhibits moderate demand variability (CV=0.481) averaging 962.7 units per working day, with a mild downward trend and sporadic zero-demand periods classifying it as Mixed/Lumpy. Lead times are unstable (CV=0.544) with a bimodal pattern suggesting two delivery modes (~1 day express, ~3 day standard). An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with EOQ-based order sizing (5,103 units) and a statistically-derived safety stock (1,894 units) achieves the 95% service level while reducing total annual inventory costs by 83.9% versus the current SAP MOQ-only approach.

research_insights.selected_model: (r,Q) continuous-review policy with EOQ order sizing
research_insights.selection_rationale: Daily demand with moderate CV, a fixed MOQ of 300, and continuously observable inventory levels favour a continuous-review (r,Q) policy. The EOQ (5,103 units) substantially exceeds the MOQ, making economic order sizing dominant. Periodic review would be less responsive given the unstable lead times.
